summary: Iteration 32: Successfully tested responsive navigation bar and social features (follow/block). All 7 nav items visible on both desktop (1280px) and mobile (390px). Follow/unfollow, block/unblock endpoints work correctly. UserProfilePage shows follow button, chat button, 3-dot menu with Block/Report options, and Tarjetas tab. Blocked user screen displays correctly with unblock option.
seed_data_creation: Created second test user (testuser2@bruno.com) for follow/block testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 32 verified all social features. Bottom nav visible on all screen sizes (no md:hidden). Follow/block endpoints work with toggle behavior. Block auto-unfollows in both directions. UserProfilePage has all required elements: profile-follow-btn, profile-chat-btn, profile-menu-btn, profile-menu-dropdown, block-user-btn, report-user-btn, profile-followers-count, profile-following-count, tab-cards. MyProfilePage has my-followers-count, my-following-count with clickable modals (followers-modal). Blocked user screen shows 'Has bloqueado a este usuario' with Desbloquear button.

bottom_nav_mobile.details: All 7 nav items visible on 390px mobile viewport
